ui.privacy_sub: Data handling, browser local storage, and GitHub Pages infrastructure
ui.privacy_sec_collection_title: 1. Zero Personal Data Collection by Digitinho
ui.privacy_sec_collection_desc: Digitinho is a static client-side web application. The game does not operate any backend server, remote database, registration forms, or user account systems. We do not request, collect, process, or sell any personal data such as names, emails, documents, or phone numbers.
ui.privacy_sec_storage_desc: All game state — such as scores, save slots, unlocked words in the Library, achievements, audio toggles, difficulty, and color themes — is stored exclusively inside your browser's local storage (localStorage). These files never leave your device and can be permanently deleted at any time through your browser settings or the in-game Save Slots manager.
ui.privacy_sec_hosting_title: 3. Hosting Infrastructure & GitHub Pages Technical Logs
ui.privacy_sec_hosting_desc: Digitinho is hosted as a static website on GitHub Pages (operated by GitHub, Inc. / Microsoft). When accessing the site, GitHub servers may automatically receive and log technical network information, such as IP addresses, access timestamps, user-agent headers, and requested URLs, for security, infrastructure defense, and abuse prevention purposes in accordance with the GitHub Privacy Statement. The Digitinho author does not have access to raw IP logs or use them to identify visitors.
ui.privacy_sec_cookies_title: 4. No Tracking Cookies or Third-Party Analytics
ui.privacy_sec_cookies_desc: The game does not use advertising cookies, Google Analytics, social media trackers, or third-party behavioral profiling scripts. The experience is 100% focused on gameplay and typing practice.
ui.privacy_sec_lgpd_title: 5. LGPD & ANPD Compliance (Brazilian Data Protection Law)
ui.privacy_sec_lgpd_desc: In adherence to Brazilian Law No. 13,709/2018 (LGPD) and the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) guidelines, this project follows the core principles of purpose limitation, necessity, data minimization, and transparency. As Digitinho does not collect or treat personal data, no personal data is shared, sold, or transferred.
ui.privacy_sec_opensource_desc: Digitinho is an open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Anyone can inspect, verify, and audit the complete source code on GitHub to confirm the absence of hidden trackers, telemetry, or remote data collection.
ui.privacy_link_github: GitHub Pages: Operation and IP Logging
ui.privacy_link_anpd: ANPD: Personal Data Concept & Processing Agents
ui.privacy_link_lgpd: LGPD — General Personal Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018)
ui.privacy_updated: Last updated: October 2026 • Digitinho Typing Game
ui.privacy_contact_desc: Since this is a client-side open-source project with no servers or data collection, questions or suggestions can be submitted directly through the GitHub repository by opening an Issue.
